MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA 🚦

Asahan ang mabigat na daloy ng trapiko sa mga sumusunod na kalsada sa September 7, 10, at 14, 2025, mula 2:00AM - 7:00AM at 2:00PM - 7:00PM, upang bigyang-daan ang isasagawang 2025 Bar Examinations na gaganapin sa New Era University (NEU) sa kahabaan ng Central Avenue, Quezon City:

• Commonwealth Ave. papasok ng Central Ave.
• Visayas Ave. papasok ng Central Ave.

Samantala, mananatili namang bukas ang iba pang kalsada para sa regular na daloy ng trapiko, ngunit mahigpit na ipapatupad ang NO PARKING sa kahabaan ng Central Avenue.

Mahigpit ding ipinagbabawal ang SALUBONG, PANINIGARILYO, at MAGUGULO/MAIINGAY NA AKTIBIDAD sa kahabaan ng Central Avenue.

Magtutulungan at nakaantabay ang mga tauhan ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) at Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS) para maisaayos ang daloy ng trapiko sa nasabing lugar.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.

IN PHOTOS | Residents of Barangay San Miguel in Calumpit, Bulacan, are seen submerged in floodwaters on Monday (September 08). The area continues to be heavily affected due to its position as a catch basin for floodwaters from the Pampanga River, land subsidence, and rising sea levels from Manila Bay. 

The Village Chief of Meysulao reported that about 80 percent of the village is underwater, as he points out the unfinished flood control project, which could have helped prevent the Pampanga River's high tide waters from flooding their community.

📷 Manny Palmero 

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.

#MSNews | The Supreme Court’s (SC) Office of the 2025 Bar Chairperson (OBC) is ready to provide transport to stranded Bar candidates in case of flooding.

In a press briefing on Sunday, Supreme Court (SC) Associate Justice Amy Lazaro-Javier, Bar chairperson said they have prepared contingency plans in case of heavy rains and flooding occur.

“We have it covered, among others, we were ready with buses to ferry our bartakers wherever they might be stranded… We are ready,” she noted. | via Pot Chavez

📸 Norman Cruz
